Furman says Congress ultimately must address the fiscal imbalance through spending cuts, tax increases, or both. He also weighs in on the economic impact of AI, arguing meaningful productivity gains may still be one to three years away as businesses learn how to deploy the technology. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

Subramanyam calls for a national strategy to site data centers where sufficient power can be provided without negatively affecting surrounding communities and expresses skepticism about "bring your own power" proposals that rely on diesel backup generators. He says the US should remain a leader in AI, but communities should not have to shoulder the costs of the infrastructure needed to power it. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Set to Cut Canada Auto Tariffs to 15% in Trade Deal
title_cn: 特朗普将在贸易协议中将加拿大汽车关税削减至 15%
summary: The Trump administration is poised to reduce tariffs on automobiles imported from Canada to 15% from 25% as part of a broader deal that would see the US neighbor drop retaliatory trade measures, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Anxious Manufacturers Await Canada-US Deal to Avoid 50% Tariffs
title_cn: 焦虑的制造商等待加拿大与美国达成避免 50% 关税的协议
summary: Canadian companies facing 50% tariffs on exports to the US remained in limbo as President Donald Trump delayed a deadline to finalize a deal until Friday — prolonging uncertainty weighing on Canada’s economy.

title: Trump’s Fast-Track Presidency Hits Pause on Tariffs, Iran and DC Makeover
title_cn: 特朗普的快速总统任期在关税、伊朗和华盛顿改造问题上暂停
summary: After racing through his second-term agenda, the president is now taking his time on his signature policies — sometimes not by choice.

title: Trump Says He May Lower Tariffs on Canada to Other Countries' Levels (Q&A)
title_cn: 特朗普表示他可能会将加拿大的关税降低至其他国家的水平（问答）
summary: President Trump told reporters that he may lower tariffs on Canada to a level consistent with other countries, after earlier Bloomberg reporting that the US is set to halve tariffs on Canadian exports of steel and aluminum. President Trump said that he has a 'very nice relationship' with Canadian leadership right now as the two countries settle on a trade deal. The president also discussed the AI industry, telling reporters that he is planning to meet with 'AI people' next week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Asks Congress to Pass Crypto Bill Alongside Executives
title_cn: 特朗普要求国会与高管一起通过加密货币法案
summary: President Donald Trump pressed Congress to pass digital asset market structure legislation that is a top priority for the industry, as he hosted cryptocurrency executives at the White House on Wednesday.
